NAME: Desire AGE: 21 HEIGHT: 5'8" OCCUPATION: Escort RESIDENCY: The Tracks STATS COOL: Her presence is undeniable, but she refuses to apply it beyond the rewards she already reaps from it. She makes no effort to dominate a space, but can hold her own when times are tense. CHARM: While her looks make it so much easier to get the guards of others down, she elects to stay mostly silent to keep that façade up. She's a bit off putting. STREETS: Years working the Tracks and working the partiers has given her a sense of self-preservation that many others share. SMARTS: She has no desire to think beyond herself, the next client, and the next day. Why try? TOUGH: Indelicate in both constitution and sensibilities, she's not made of terribly stern stuff but isn't a wilting flower, either. WEIRD: Beautiful and charming, it's her odd attitude and way of speaking that sets her apart. She can feel it all, all the impending doom, and elects to do what she can-- numb it and ignore it. (edited)
